sources.finding: Single-pool input/output quote parameters are tokenIn,address;tokenOut,address;amount,uint256;fee,uint24;limit,uint160. Four returns: amount,uint256;price,uint160;ticks,uint32;gas,uint256.

Quotes revert pool swaps in the callback; price after is retained in return. Zero limit maps to direction-specific TickMath endpoint offset by one. Exact-output callback checks cached required output. Gas estimate covers the swap/revert only.
